mapper.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT quest.user_id, account.nickname, quest.score, quest.completed_at, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY quest.score DESC ) AS rank_no FROM daily_quests quest INNER JOIN users account ON account.user_id = quest.user_id WHERE quest.quest_date = #{questDate} AND quest.status = 'COMPLETED' AND quest.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND account.role_code = 'USER' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, rank_no, nickname, score, completed_at FROM ranked WHERE user_id = #{userId}
